'''Deam Schween''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Schween worked in [[the Chasm]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the city of [[Gadrin]], where he was employed as a comedian. He typically used insult comedy and would mock people to make the cantina's patrons laugh. He was present when the cantina was attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] and the following day, he told the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating the incident, about what had happened.
